record.one_liner: Open-source CRM, available as Twenty Cloud or self-hosted, with REST and GraphQL APIs generated from each workspace schema.
record.auth_notes: Workspace API key created under Settings -> Developers -> API (Bearer token). The REST/GraphQL API also accepts OAuth 2.0 access tokens (authorization code + PKCE, and client credentials) with dynamic client registration and an 'api' scope. critic: auth_methods [api_key] -> [api_key, oauth2]; the draft claimed OAuth was MCP-only but docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/oauth documents OAuth for Core and Metadata APIs.
record.access_notes: Self-hosting the open-source core is free and API keys are created in-app. Cloud has a 30-day free trial without a card, then paid per-user plans (Pro $9/user/month). critic: access confirmed self_serve_free via free self-hosting.
record.api_notes: Core API covers CRUD on records (people, companies, opportunities, custom objects); Metadata API manages objects, fields and relations. Both REST and GraphQL, batch up to 60 records per request.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready confirmed; self-serve credentials plus documented public API, no review step found.
